verdict.rationale: Omarchy is installed via a bootable ISO that takes over the whole machine (comm-14) and even supports dual-boot alongside Windows on a single partition (omarchy-docs-13), implying it can also fully replace an existing OS install; a hands-on switcher confirms 'the install is uncomplicated' (comm-7). Full-disk encryption is mandatory by default (docs-14), which may add friction but doesn't block replacing the current OS.
